note: CMP-06 NotYetAvailable: when year-end salary certificates can be made. Part A comes from TRACES only after the fourth-quarter salary TDS return (January to March) is filed, so the certificates page says they are available after that return's due date. Read with the calendar evaluator (key tds_return_q4, from the March of the tax year). Loaded by two staff through the console flow (scripts/load-rule-pack.ts, the seed). Marked verify until the compliance owner and the partner CA confirm it.

ruleSets.source: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.31A(2) (the quarterly statement for January to March is due by 31 May); Income-tax Act, 2025 and its rules carry the same date for tax years from 2026-27.
